### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** 76b4f44ed61435926011c38fe4c1a6ff6a0cff10

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** Deferred Review Nitpick

#### Expected Behavior

The context-request protocol section shared by all `code-reviewer-*.md` agent files should live in one authoritative location (e.g., an included fragment or the contract doc), so a single edit propagates everywhere.

#### Actual Behavior

A ~31-line "Context-Request Protocol" boilerplate block (lines 83-110 in each agent file) is copy-pasted verbatim across 10+ agent files:
- `plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-deep-arch.md`
- `plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-deep-correctness.md`
- `plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-deep-hygiene.md`
- `plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-deep-verification.md`
- And ~6 more code-reviewer-*.md files

If the context-request contract changes (e.g., new action type, updated JSON format), all 10+ files must be updated in sync. Observed during PR #69 llm-review (finding: "multiple agent files have identical boilerplate for the context-request protocol section").
data.title: [code-reviewer-agents]: Context-request protocol block copy-pasted across 10+ agent files -> Contract changes require editing every file
